changelog:
- Initial release of the pure-water-specialist skill.
- Provides technical support for pure water and ultra-pure water system design, installation, commissioning, and operation.
- Covers process design, equipment selection, system commissioning, troubleshooting, and typical process combinations (RO, EDI, ion exchange, etc.).
- Includes documentation templates and key design/maintenance considerations.
- Suitable for industrial, electronics, and pharmaceutical water treatment applications.
summary: Use this skill when the user needs help with pure water and ultra-pure water system design, installation, commissioning, and operations.
